name: V100 SXM2 32GB
notes: release_date of 2017-05-10 is confirmed for the original V100 platform/16GB SXM2 launch (GTC 2017 keynote). The specific 32GB SXM2 SKU modeled in this record was a later memory-capacity refresh (widely cited elsewhere as following around GTC 2018, March 2018), and a dedicated NVIDIA press release explicitly announcing '32GB' as its own dated event was not found in the research pass for this record -- record this date with LOWER confidence for the 32GB variant specifically than it would carry for the original 16GB launch; treat as the best available anchor date pending a follow-up source. TF32/BF16/FP8/FP64-Tensor-Core/structured-sparsity fields are null because Volta predates all of these (introduced starting with Ampere) -- not merely unpublished. FP16 Tensor Core figure (125 TFLOPS) is inherently dense; sparsity as a concept did not exist yet, so fp16_tensor_sparse_tflops is left null rather than treated as equal to the dense figure. INT8 Tensor Core throughput not found in NVIDIA's official V100 datasheet -- it lists only a single 'Tensor Performance' (FP16) row, no INT8 TOPS breakout, so int8_tensor_tops is left null rather than estimated. multi_instance_max is null because MIG was not introduced until Ampere -- V100 predates it entirely (confirmed via NVIDIA's official MIG User Guide supported-GPU list, which starts at Ampere GA100/Hopper). pcie_generation/pcie_bandwidth_gbps are null because the SXM2 form factor's official 'System Interface' is NVLink, not PCIe (PCIe applies only to the separate V100 PCIe/V100S PCIe SKUs, not modeled here). nvlink_generation of 2 reflects the commonly-used 'NVLink 2.0' designation; the datasheet itself only states '2X higher throughput compared to the previous generation [Pascal]' without using the literal string 'NVLink 2.0'. nvlink_max_domain_size of 8 reflects the DGX-1/HGX-1 8-GPU SXM2 baseboard convention, though V100's NVLink topology (hybrid cube-mesh) is not a fully-connected any-to-any mesh like later NVSwitch-based systems -- recorded as GPU count in the baseboard, not a claim about full connectivity. sm_count not found in any official source checked.

_sources.release_date: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-launches-revolutionary-volta-gpu-platform-fueling-next-era-of-ai-and-high-performance-computing (GTC 2017, May 10 2017 -- V100 platform launch date; the 32GB SXM2 SKU specifically is a later, unconfirmed-date memory refresh, see notes)
_sources.multi_instance_max: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/mig-user-guide/supported-gpus.html (MIG-supported GPU list begins at Ampere GA100/Hopper; V100 absent)
